summary: Backend engineer who builds reliable Python and Java services for logistics and healthcare platforms.

bullets.text: Built a Python and FastAPI service that routes 2M shipment events per day, cutting p95 latency by 40%
Migrated 30 services from VMs to Kubernetes on AWS, reducing infrastructure cost by $250K per year
Mentored 4 engineers and led design reviews for the platform team
Introduced CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, raising deploy frequency from weekly to daily
Developed REST APIs in Java and Spring for a patient scheduling product used by 120 clinics
Tuned PostgreSQL queries and indexes, cutting report generation from 10 minutes to 45 seconds
Collaborated with product and design to ship 3 major releases
Responsible for on-call support and incident response for the scheduling API
